snippet.title: First look at CREOVIA Sandbox MMO! (Fish Preparation)
snippet.description:
Here's one of the first insight videos displaying the fish preparation in Creovia.

Creovia is a social 2D Sandbox MMO-RPG, where the goal is to explore, fight monsters, collect items and enjoy various activities alongside your friends and thousands of other players.

We offer an immersive world generation & editing system, which allows the user to express their creativity with the tools we provide.
There's something for everybody! (Quests, Fishing, Building, Chatting, Multiplayer, PvE)

Nostalgic for the hearty and welcoming indie communities? Well, look no further.
Join us on Discord!
https://discord.gg/bt6UpeamgT

Special thanks to Avi, CrissOfc, Berlin (Fz), Pie, Joe Daoud and me :)
